simple.meaning: אֹסֶף (ʼôçeph) is a Hebrew word meaning “a collection (of fruits).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֹסֶף (H625) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 32:10, with occurrences in Isaiah, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֹסֶף (H625) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֹסֶף (H625) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֹסֶף (ʼôçeph) / H625 is traced through Isaiah 32:10, Isaiah 33:4, Micah 7:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
